description: Land Title Settlement Department - Niyangama, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad Map No. 320019 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
